meta.title: Lumina — AI photo generator and editor
meta.description: Upload your photos, pick a theme, and AI creates new shots in that style.

hero.title: Your photos, anywhere you like
hero.subtitle: Upload a few photos of yourself, pick a theme, and AI creates new pictures while keeping your look.

beforeAfter.title: Before and after
beforeAfter.subtitle: Drag the slider to compare the original photo with the result.
beforeAfter.placeholder: Placeholder example. Real examples will appear once AI is connected.

upload.title: Upload photos
upload.text: One or more where your face is clearly visible. From a computer or straight from your phone camera.

theme.title: Pick a theme
theme.text: Vacation, business portrait, holiday, or your own description.

save.title: Edit and save
save.text: Crop, adjust colors, and download one photo or all at once.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: More themes are on the way.

family.title: Family photoshoot
family.description: Warm shots with the whole family

studio.title: Studio portrait
studio.description: Professional light and a clean backdrop

custom.title: Your own theme
custom.description: Describe the scene in your own words

create.title: Create photos
create.comingSoon: This section arrives in the next stages: photo upload, theme selection, and generation.

gallery.title: My photos
gallery.comingSoon: Your private gallery will live here. Photos are kept for 30 days.

footer.privacy: Only you can see your photos. They are deleted automatically after 30 days.
